checks: The cyclic field normalization is an actual finite etale torsor over root_e; its base change is root_n(Y_V). The original tame band therefore extends before constructing the gerbe.

For a realized lifting gerbe, strict-local Kummer H2 vanishing and group-to-etale H2 injection give an actual finite central lift. Finite objects descend from the strict localization. Difference torsors have inertia dividing n; their extensions and triple coherence construct the specified gerbe on root_en.

The preimage of mu_h in total inertia, not a presumed split copy of mu_h, acts through one character on a sector anchor. End(A) is an honest scalar-zero algebra with trivial mu_h action and descends Azumaya to root_m.

Algebraic anchors exist via the cyclic residue splitting cover. Coherent module extension/reflexive hull is used only pointwise; actual all-ring Morita families and homogeneous free bases provide the family scope.
Cross-sector coefficient exponents c+h*l, 0<=c<h, yield exact one-carry composition and at most p-1 Frobenius carry. Within-phase object maps have offset zero. I=O(-hD_n) has F*I=I^p.
Sector alignment changes residual degree by less than d-prime; normalized one-step lines have O(v*m) degree. Minimal windows and normal tails therefore need O(E*m), not O(E*n), compressed layers.

Fixed partial resolutions and all-ring finite Hom constructions apply to actual sector objects and maps. Finite diagrams have bounded composition length; the a-fold word is used only in the frame equivalence, never expanded into coordinate equations.

The final deck operation and its actual gerbe 2-cocycle are retained. The oriented nu-step skew unit and a-fold fixed frames give the original semilinear local-system category; nilpotent equivariant maps lift uniquely.
